topic: Existing clearance FSM retry phase must retain matching lane state
sourceTrace: BuildingOperationStep sets private job phase REPLAN when retries change without new room progress, and publishes changed durable ClearOrder. The existing buildingOperation FSM has a Replan queue branch.

BuildingLaneJournal nevertheless admitted only ENTRY/SWEEP for SAVE/EXPORT/FROZEN/CHECK/ADOPT. SAVE returned false for REPLAN; an older published lane snapshot could remain while retry state changed. Current producer context also refused REPLAN.

Current discovery resumes ClearOrder directly through CortexClearBuilding, whose read-only lane CHECK and eventual ADOPT use BuildingLaneJournal. The missing phase enum affected the existing live journal/resume path, not only the new private capture.
implementation: Admit REPLAN alongside ENTRY/SWEEP at lane phase admission and snapshot phase validation, with the unchanged13-field version1 schema. Adopt exact original routes, pending allocations, cursors, request ages and phase through existing validation; never create a fresh route or budget.

Admit REPLAN in shared producer context under the same original hard-deadline branch as ENTRY/SWEEP. Outgoing version5 capture retains REPLAN lanes and empty egress. No outer schema change or incoming consumer added.

All original exact visit/transform/node/roster/operation/epoch/native guards, bounded copying, changed-only writes and1.5second SAVE throttle remain. Phase change still invalidates the old phase sample as designed.
cost: REPLAN now performs the existing bounded lane validation/copy at its existing phase-change/1.5second publication boundary instead of skipping it. No new worker, world scan, retry or timer. Added required work has no measured performance claim.
limits: This removes a source-proven phase gap; no in-engine replication/order failure or successful migration is claimed.
Authentication cannot be derived from the server's private epoch or a mix of public journals. Full original-producer registration/seal/request replay remains unimplemented.
Original follow-through/early-exit/reserve, deleted actor identity, actor motion/settings/interruption/retirement domains and actual native incoming readiness remain incomplete.
Actual normal/HC locality, CQB flow/repeats/Zeus, balance and5percent median/10percent p95 remain unverified. Audits paused.
